description: Check whether the user can deploy right now and what is missing: whether Cloudflare is connected (including the one-time workers.dev subdomain step, which otherwise only fails after a deploy) and, given a workflowId, which services its nodes need that are not connected yet (`missingProviders`). Call it early, while building, so the user can fix setup in parallel. After request_connections, call it again with that sessionId to poll the user's progress: `connectionRequest.complete` turns true once they are done. Never returns a secret.

sessionId.description: A sessionId from request_connections, to poll that request's progress.

workflowId.description: Also report which services this workflow still needs connected.

name: check_setup
title: Check setup
